## 2025-10-27 - LLM Output Trust Gap (XSS)
**Vulnerability:** `markdown-it` was configured with `html: true` in `NewsGallery.vue` to render content generated by an LLM (`generate_news.py`).
**Learning:** We often implicitly trust LLM outputs as "safe" text, but they can be manipulated (via prompt injection or hallucination) to produce malicious HTML/JavaScript. Treating LLM output as untrusted user input is a critical security boundary.
**Prevention:** Always disable HTML rendering (`html: false`) when displaying Markdown from LLMs unless absolutely necessary and strictly sanitized.
